headline: AMD forecasts topping Intel in revenue
dek: Its $17 billion outlook sits above Intel's own guidance, per Canaltech.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: Two outlooks
body: AMD guides to about $17 billion for the fourth quarter, per Canaltech and Xataka.
Intel guides to between $15 billion and $16 billion for the same period (Canaltech).

points.t: Microsoft, Meta, OpenAI and Oracle buy the racks.
Struggles to fill its Xeon orders.

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: The gap has narrowed
body: In 2021, Intel earned almost five times more than AMD, per Xataka.
In 2025 it was $52.9 billion for Intel against $34.6 billion for AMD (Xataka).

stat.cap: AMD outlook for next quarter, says Canaltech

items.t: The figures are the companies' own projections.
Lisa Su expects shipments to fall in 2027 (Canaltech).

caption.hook: AMD forecasts $17 billion in fourth-quarter revenue, above the Intel revenue forecast.
body: Per Canaltech and Xataka, Intel guides to between $15 billion and $16 billion. If AMD's forecast holds, it would be the first time its quarterly revenue tops its rival's. These are the companies' own estimates, not closed results.

Xataka recalls that in 2021 Intel earned almost five times more. AMD's growth comes from data centers, now 64% of revenue, with Helios systems bought by Microsoft, Meta, OpenAI and Oracle. Intel still struggles to fill Xeon orders.
